newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets await fresh incentive.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets await fresh incentive.

text.p: Cotton prices in Europe were largely unchanged in quiet, featureless trade on Friday despite a stronger showing for the commodity on the New York futures exchange, industry sources said.
Trading had yet to return to normal after the holiday season and fundamental news was in short supply, they said.
Middling 1-1/32 inch cottons saw some price testing activity with U.S. and Australian origins quoted up 0.25 cents a lb but the market for the most popular Central Asian styles was extremely quiet.
